findingDetails.title: The parent spec contradicts itself on whether the packet is complete
findingDetails.claim: spec.md:50 states Status Complete while the same document marks phases 2-4 In progress/Pending/Pending at :136-138 and its continuity block says phase 002 is uncommitted at :13.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the phase map is a historical snapshot; it is presented as current state with a Status column and the spec calls itself the aggregate progress tracker at :147.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The Status row was advanced when the goal was reconciled and the phase map was not updated in the same pass.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: the phase map being explicitly labeled historical in a future edit

findingDetails.title: One acceptance row says Met and the same file's evidence says Unmet
findingDetails.claim: AC-013 ends its table row Met while the evidence paragraph at :86 says Unmet and the frontmatter at :13 says AC-013-014 Unmet.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the full AC-013 block at :265-272; it repeats the Unmet reasoning and no later row withdraws it.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The row was corrected to Met after the advisor rebuild and the evidence paragraph was left behind.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a recorded run of the AC-013 command showing the compiled route present, plus the evidence paragraph updated

findingDetails.title: The closure gate still blocks a phase whose commits are on origin/main
findingDetails.claim: AC-014 is Unmet and its evidence says commit/push remains open, while e3beac65f4 and 1218b94938 are ancestors of origin/main and HEAD equals origin/main.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the validator half is unmet in a way the commit does not settle; the evidence paragraph says the validator printed RESULT: PASSED and only commit/push was open.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The row predates the commit and the closure was never re-evaluated.

findingDetails.title: Phase 3's closure gate is unmet while the goal reports the phase done
findingDetails.claim: AC-026 and AC-027 are Unmet and the status line says the phase waits on review, commit and push, while goal.md:112 records the phase Done and e00fef3e76 is in origin/main history.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched for the review artifact AC-027 names; no review directory and no review-report file exists under the packet and scratch is empty.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The reviews ran as in-session dispatches whose report lived in a temp file; the work may be done but the record cannot show it.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: an artifact showing AC-026 and AC-027 satisfied

findingDetails.title: Phase 2's implementation summary still calls the work uncommitted
findingDetails.claim: The summary states In progress (~90%); implementation remains uncommitted at :41 and :54 while the commits are on origin/main.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: None needed; the claim is a state statement the remote contradicts.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Written before the commit and never revised.

findingDetails.title: Phase 3's own spec and summary still point at commit-and-push work
findingDetails.claim: The phase spec says Status In Progress and the summary next action is run the next review then commit and push, while the goal says the phase is done and committed.

findingDetails.title: The 003-to-004 handoff expected test count no longer matches the suite
findingDetails.claim: The handoff expects 16 tests from two vitest files that now define eight and eleven cases, nineteen in total.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the handoff runs a filtered subset; it names the two files with no filter.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Three cases were added after the handoff block was written.

findingDetails.title: AC-027's proof is an ephemeral temp file
findingDetails.claim: AC-027 is proven by tailing /tmp/phase3-review.txt, a path that cannot survive the session, and no review report exists in the packet.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the packet and specs/sk-code for a durable review artifact; none.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The review was an in-session dispatch whose output was deliberately not committed.

findingDetails.title: D1's hub composition predates a fourth packet
findingDetails.claim: D1 says the hub keeps three packets; mode-registry.json now declares four modes, adding sk-code-ci as a second surface packet.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether D1 is scoped to the two departing surfaces rather than the hub inventory; its wording is an inventory statement repeated in the phase-2 row.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: D1 is a frozen decision about what this packet leaves behind; a later packet adding a surface does not violate its intent.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a parent-spec edit recording the later surface addition

results.notes: Four P1 record contradictions; implementation matches its spec.
Two phase closure gates carry Unmet rows while the goal reports Done.
